findings: A exactly reproduces historical MP02 numeric parameters; both variants retain identical image weights, mutable support and original native initialization.
Revision02 has actual right thumb/middle anchors and corresponding mutable controls, fixing first-attempt admission-role failure. Left usable-carry finger controls remain frozen on all129frames.
Fresh heldout image distances improve slightly, but both image references report11 additional supported-finger motion failures and14 additional wrist-motion failures for B directly against A.
Right whole-carry worst skin depth improves24.125 to23.253mm, while fixed pose-usable carry worst depth increases14.027 to16.274mm, exceeding the frozen+2mm guard. Both scopes must remain visible.
Left carry mean41.270/worst104.112mm is unchanged; the severe estimated hand/object compatibility conflict and frozen hidden finger state are unresolved.
Own-anchor residual reduction is a fitting diagnostic, not improved physical contact or sufficient grounds to train a contact model.
Release290..359 has zero sampled hand-skin penetration for both methods; source-faithful opening/timing still requires separately recorded image/video review.
